target.title: fix(reply): prevent foreground delivery deadlock
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

WhatsApp replies could finish model generation but remain undelivered when a newer same-session inbound arrived during the previous turn's final delivery. The foreground freshness fence waited for the newer generation, while queued follow-up admission waited for the older owner's delivery barrier, creating a circular wait. A later inbound could re-kick the queue and make the stranded reply appear.

Closes #99061.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep stale-reply suppression for independent newer turns, but temporarily suspend only the queued generation whose admission is explicitly waiting on the older owner's delivery barrier. The dispatch-scoped callback travels with each `FollowupRun`, including collect and overflow-summary transformations, so an active drain cannot reuse a stale runner closure's fence identity. Fence snapshots also retain their state identity so a delayed callback cannot collide with a recreated generation number.

## User Impact

Concurrent WhatsApp messages no longer strand the previous completed reply behind a circular delivery/admission wait. Independent newer turns still suppress stale older replies as before. No config, protocol, or plugin API changes.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/queue/drain.identity-guard.test.ts` — 2 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/dispatch.freshness.test.ts src/auto-reply/dispatch.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-from-config.reply-dispatch.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/reply-flow.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/reply-turn-admission.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/followup-runner.test.ts` — 179 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs` on all 11 changed files — passed.
- Testbox-through-Crabbox `tbx_01kwrhrwx9whq4h8c2rwqmvzms` — exact 11-file `check:changed` overlay passed; [Actions run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28732927268).
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output` — final review clean; no accepted/actionable findings.
